svg.text: Figure 6. The local sort on one tile: 16 keys, 4 decimal digits
Pass 1 brings the keys in by augmenting, so each becomes key|position, and counts digit 1 (the ones). Each later pass buckets
the records by one digit, stably, and counts the next digit. The two 1307s keep their input order, 01 before 06.
Under each column: the counts of the digit counted during that pass (HIST) and their exclusive prefix sum, which is where each
bucket starts in the next pass (PTR). Yellow: the digit a pass buckets by. Underlined in blue: the digit it counts.
